results.title: Huayou, seeking control of Ghana’s Ewoyaa lithium mine, faces scrutiny over compensation delays in Congo
results.content: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt, the Chinese company seeking to acquire Atlantic Lithium, the developer of Ghana’s Ewoyaa lithium mine, is facing scrutiny in the Democratic Republic of Congo over delayed compensation to communities affected by pollution from one of its subsidiaries.

results.title: Analysis: Presidency says new national airline is viable. Government should publish the reports
results.content: The Presidency says preliminary studies have confirmed that Ghana’s proposed national airline is viable.

results.title: ADB launches Green-Grow scheme to empower smallholder vegetable farmers
results.content: Agricultural Development Bank (ADB) PLC has launched its Green-Grow Vegetable Farmers Lending Scheme to expand access to structured agricultural financing and boost local vegetable production.

results.title: Bawumia wants political parties to commit to long-term national development plans
results.content: Former Vice President and NPP flagbearer Dr Mahamudu Bawumia has urged Ghana’s political parties to agree on long-term development plans that will remain in force even when power changes hands.

results.title: Without media, economic policy means nothing to citizens – Dr Asiama
results.content: Economic policies mean little to citizens if they do not understand them, Dr Johnson Pandit Asiama, Governor of the Bank of Ghana (BoG), said, describing the media as an essential partner in promoting public understanding of economic developments.

results.title: Over 120 advertising boards pulled down in NRSA operation across Accra
results.content: The National Road Safety Authority (NRSA) has dismantled more than 120 advertising boards erected without authorisation on road medians in parts of Greater Accra.

results.title: Ghana targets investment-grade rating to unlock cheaper long-term financing
results.content: The government is pursuing an investment-grade credit rating as part of efforts to reduce borrowing costs, attract more investors and expand financing opportunities for businesses under its New Economy programme.

results.title: Ghanaian teenager dies in fatal shooting in Canada
results.content: An 18-year-old Ghanaian, Prince Abdul Malik, has been shot dead in Canada, with Toronto police investigating the circumstances surrounding his killing.

results.title: Media owners must invest in training, safety and fair remuneration – Kwakye Ofosu
results.content: Felix Kwake Ofosu, Minister in charge of Government Communications, has urged media owners and stakeholders to invest in professional training, improve working conditions, and be responsible for the safety of journalists as they perform their duties.

results.title: Mother of quadruplets appeals for support as cost of childcare mounts
results.content: A mother of four one-year-old boys at Gorm in the Ada East District has appealed for financial and material support as the rising cost of caring for the four children overwhelms the family’s limited resources.

results.title: Journalists are not enemies of the state, security institutions – Dwumfour
results.content: Albert Kwabena Dwumfour, President of the Ghana Journalists Association (GJA), has called for justice for media practitioners attacked or assaulted in the line of duty.

results.title: COCOBOD relaunches free fertiliser distribution programme in Western North Region
results.content: The Ghana Cocoa Board (COCOBOD has officially re-launched the Free Fertiliser Distribution Programme as part of the government’s commitment to support cocoa farmers to improve farm productivity.

results.title: Yagbonwura calls for stronger collaboration among traditional authorities to promote peace
results.content: Yagbonwura Bii-Kunuto Jewu Soale I, King and Overlord of the Gonja Kingdom and President of the Savannah Regional House of Chiefs, has called for stronger collaboration among traditional authorities across the country to promote peace, good governance and community development.

results.title: SEC assures low-cost investment schemes to deepen financial inclusion
results.content: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has reaffirmed its commitment to deepening inclusive access to Ghana’s capital market through low-cost investment schemes, micro-investment products, crowdfunding and digital platforms, particularly for first-time and small-scale investors.

results.title: Chiefs commend ADAMUS CEO for support to Esiama SHS
results.content: Traditional rulers and stakeholders in Esiama have commended Angela Dialla Attieh, CEO of ADAMUS Resources Limited, a subsidiary of Nguvu Mining Company Limited, for the company’s support towards the development of the Esiama Senior High Technical School (ESHTS).

results.title: Is BoG squeezing jobs to tame inflation? – Oppong Nkrumah questions policy stance
results.content: The Ranking Member of Parliament for the Economy and Development Committee, Kojo Oppong Nkrumah, has questioned whether the Bank of Ghana’s efforts to lower inflation are putting unnecessary pressure on businesses, job creation, and economic growth.

results.title: Year-round farming key to cutting food imports – Agric Minister
results.content: Agriculture Minister Eric Opoku says Ghana must expand irrigation and support year-round farming to boost food production and reduce dependence on imports.

results.title: Ghana nears finish line in external debt restructuring – GSDR
results.content: Ghana’s external debt restructuring is nearing completion, with 16 of 25 bilateral agreements with official creditors finalised, according to the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable (GSDR).

results.title: Cruise ship pianist rescued from sea after nine hours in Pacific Ocean
results.content: A cruise ship pianist was found treading water around 20 miles (32km) off the Californian coast after falling overboard, according to US media reports.

results.title: Fidelity Bank picks Atta Yeboah Gyan as MD, pending BoG approval
results.content: Fidelity Bank's Board has selected Deputy Managing Director Atta Yeboah Gyan as the bank’s next Managing Director, effective November 21, 2026.

results.title: After midterm rout, Vance tries to build his own 2028 brand
results.content: Late in his blitz to salvage Republicans' midterm fortunes, Vice President JD Vance shifted strategy. He talked less about President Donald Trump and more about the issues that define his own political identity.

results.title: Trump to meet Qatar’s prime minister as Iran diplomacy faces hurdles
results.content: President Donald Trump will meet with Qatar's prime minister at the White House on Monday, ​according to the White House schedule, as the ‌conflict with Iran drags on and diplomatic efforts to end it face significant obstacles.

results.title: Tanzanian opposition leader cleared of treason, sentenced for incitement
results.content: Tanzania's main opposition leader, Tundu Lissu, was cleared ​of treason but convicted of incitement and sentenced to four years in jail on Friday, in a case that rights groups and ‌his supporters say is politically motivated.

results.title: At least 21 dead after migrant boat sinks off Senegal coast, government says
results.content: At least 21 people have ​died after a boat carrying ‌migrants sank off the Senegalese coast, the interior ministry said on Sunday.

results.title: Gold gains more than 1% as softer oil prices ease inflation worries
results.content: Gold rose more than 1% on Monday ‌as softer oil prices eased inflation concerns, while investors awaited key US inflation data and fresh signals from the Federal Reserve on its policy outlook.

results.title: Trump says he is highly unlikely to order Iran strikes if talks progress
results.content: US President Donald Trump said on Sunday he was highly unlikely to order fresh attacks on Iran as long as talks to end the conflict progress, even as both countries reported that ​shipping had been hit in or near the Strait of Hormuz.

results.title: Oil falls as Trump says new Iran attacks ‘unlikely’
results.content: Oil prices fell at Monday's open after US President Donald Trump said he was highly unlikely to order new Iran ​attacks while talks to end the conflict make progress, despite both nations' reports of attacks on ships in or near ‌the Strait of Hormuz.

results.title: Trump says after midterms defeat his immigration crackdown was ‘too tough’
results.content: US President Donald Trump has said his immigration crackdown was "too tough", marking one of his clearest public retreats from a defining plank of his political agenda, following his party's drubbing in the midterm elections.

results.title: Davido clears air on Naira Marley, VDM arrest plot
results.content: Davido’s logistics manager, Isreal DMW, has dismissed claims that the singer was involved in Naira Marley’s ordeal over late singer Mohbad’s death or any alleged plot to get social media activist VeryDarkMan arrested.

results.title: GPL 2025/2026 : Port City beat Basake Holy Stars to return to winning ways
results.content: Port City returned to winning ways with a 1-0 victory over Basake Holy Stars at the Daasebre Boamah Darko II Park on Sunday.
